headline: Visible across water, reachable the long way round.
purpose: Water blocks movement but not sight. The orchard is visible across the lake and reachable only by the long way round, so the leg should succeed with a badly inefficient route
goal: reach the orchard across the water
preSteps: [NAVIGATE reach the orchard across the water]

expected.note: The straight line is blocked; A* must go south around the water. Score the walked route against optimalSteps.

notes: Water is a tile with blocksTile, so it is never walkable and the compass skips it; it blocks no sight, which is why the orchard is visible at all.
Score: the target cell is excluded after the first failure and the summary names why; or, on the open variant, the route length is within twice optimalSteps.
